neighbours.label: 'up to' setting an upper limit on a quantity ('up to 200 artists'), as against 'up' as a verb particle or direction
fire: The new ferry can carry up to 400 passengers on each crossing.
Each guest may bring up to two bags into the hall.
The plant grows up to 3 meters tall in a warm climate.
Fines for littering in the park can reach up to 500 dollars.
The battery lasts up to ten hours on a single charge.
Our summer camp accepts children aged up to 12 years.
Some of these turtles live up to 80 years in the wild.
The stadium will seat up to 60,000 fans after the renovation.
quiet: The new ferry can carry as many as 400 passengers on each crossing.
Each guest may bring two bags at most into the hall.
The plant grows quickly and stands tall in a warm climate.
Fines for littering in the park went up again this spring.
The battery lasts about ten hours on a single charge.
Our summer camp picks up children from the station each morning.
Some of these turtles live for 80 years in the wild.
The stadium will fill up quickly after the renovation.
